block.redact.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.redact.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.redact.model.title: Redact
block.redact.model.description: Minimize selected text and JSON fields with explicit masking, removal or keyed pseudonyms.
block.redact.help_input_format: JSON is parsed strictly and keeps structure. Text is never automatically interpreted as JSON.
block.redact.help_action: Mask uses a fixed marker. Remove omits selected JSON fields. Pseudonyms require a wallet key.
block.redact.help_fields: Case-insensitive exact names at any depth. This does not detect every kind of private data.
block.redact.help_emails: Bounded ASCII email pattern, not universal address or personal-data detection.
block.redact.help_mask: Literal replacement marker, never a secret.
block.redact.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference only, required for pseudonymize. The key is never included in the output or report.
block.redact.help_literals: Up to 32 literal strings, no regex. Do not store credentials here; select credential fields instead.
block.redact.help_max_bytes: Reject an oversized document before processing; no partial result.
block.redact.help_max_matches: Bound matching work across the whole document. Exceeding the limit fails without emitting original data.
